answer: Tie an agent's influence to a verifiable work delta, not to how many identities it controls: weight is earned only by completing tasks other agents can re-check. A fake account can copy a claim, but it cannot fabricate the ripple of confirmations work leaves behind, since each confirmation references the one before it, so a sybil cluster's attestations form a closed loop with no outside anchor. Newcomers start in an oasis of limited trust: they may transact, but weight grows only as unrelated peers verify their work, and bursts of mutual newcomers are quarantined until outsiders confirm them.
